mapper.sql: id, sku, name, category_id, specification, price, stock, min_stock, status, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.sku, p.name, p.category_id, tpc.name as category_name, p.specification, p.price, p.stock, p.min_stock, p.status, p.create_time, p.update_time FROM t_product p LEFT JOIN t_product_category tpc ON p.category_id = tpc.id ORDER BY p.create_time DESC

SELECT p.id, p.sku, p.name, p.category_id, tpc.name as category_name, p.specification, p.price, p.stock, p.min_stock, p.status, p.create_time, p.update_time FROM t_product p LEFT JOIN t_product_category tpc ON p.category_id = tpc.id WHERE p.id = #{id}

SELECT p.id, p.sku, p.name, p.category_id, tpc.name as category_name, p.specification, p.price, p.stock, p.min_stock, p.status, p.create_time, p.update_time FROM t_product p LEFT JOIN t_product_category tpc ON p.category_id = tpc.id WHERE p.sku = #{sku}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_product SET sku = #{sku}, name = #{name}, category_id = #{categoryId}, specification = #{specification}, price = #{price}, min_stock = #{minStock}, status = #{status}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.sku, p.name, p.category_id, tpc.name as category_name, p.specification, p.price, p.stock, p.min_stock, p.status, p.create_time, p.update_time FROM t_product p LEFT JOIN t_product_category tpc ON p.category_id = tpc.id WHERE p.stock <= p.min_stock ORDER BY p.create_time DESC

SELECT p.id, p.sku, p.name, p.category_id, tpc.name as category_name, p.specification, p.price, p.stock, p.min_stock, p.status, p.create_time, p.update_time FROM t_product p LEFT JOIN t_product_category tpc ON p.category_id = tpc.id WHERE p.stock <= p.min_stock
AND p.sku LIKE CONCAT('%', #{sku}, '%')
AND p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
AND p.category_id = #{categoryId}
ORDER BY p.create_time DESC

SELECT p.id, p.sku, p.name, p.category_id, tpc.name as category_name, p.specification, p.price, p.stock, p.min_stock, p.status, p.create_time, p.update_time FROM t_product p LEFT JOIN t_product_category tpc ON p.category_id = tpc.id WHERE p.status = 'ON_SALE' ORDER BY p.create_time DESC
